study: Rutherford et al. 2014 (ST Math / Spatial-Temporal Math software RCT, JREE)
delivery_evidence: PD was 'A 4- to 5-hr professional development training session on how to use the software...provided to all study teachers' plus 1st-year technical support (p.368, Methods/Implementation); the publication does not state whether this session/support was in person, online, or remote.
test_alignment_evidence: Included effect size uses the California Standards Test (CST) math scale score, a state standardized assessment (broad, independent) not tailored to ST Math, though ST Math was designed to align with the same California standards (p.358 abstract; p.~365 measures; Table 3).
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting a specific new instructional-materials package: ST Math (MIND Research Institute) supplemental math software with its own grade-level games/curriculum that students use ~2x45 min/week in the computer lab; the teacher training is explicitly 'how to use the software' (p.~363-364 Description/Use of ST Math; p.368).
outcome_timing_evidence: Included effect is the pooled 1-year main effect on the spring CST at the end of year 1 of implementation (Table 3 'Pooled', p.373); the exploratory 2-year cumulative effect (Table 5) was not the extracted wave.
